name: netdust-devops
description: 0.2.0: make push env=<env> and structure.theme_flavour. The single source of truth for Netdust devops: the branch flow, the deploy gate and ledger, and the project/fleet contract. Ships a stack-split Makefile core (mk/wp, statamic, node, generic) that every project vendors rather than copies, so a fix made once reaches every project and `make doctor` names any project that is behind or edited in place. Owns site.yml schema 2 — environments: binds a branch to a server, and nothing else may. Replaces the flow half of netdust-core:dev-stack and both /deploy commands.
